items.name: research-ants-mandibles-1
items.title: Mandibles I
items.refnote: the first image is the Raider: take only the hooked shape of its pair of mandibles, in plain dull chitin; do not draw the ant, its head or its blue fins.
items.subject: MANDIBLES I (Raiders, Majors and Bullet Ants hit harder, the first and plainest of three levels): one pair of big hooked ant mandibles alone, curving toward each other like two thick sickles, angled diagonally, of PLAIN DULL SAND-COLOURED GROWN CHITIN, matte and slightly rough, their inner edges blunt. No gold, no amber, no blue, no glow. Only the mandibles: no head.

items.name: research-ants-mandibles-2
items.title: Mandibles II
items.subject: MANDIBLES II: the same pair of mandibles, now HARDENED GLOSSY IVORY chitin, their inner edges honed to a bright gleaming edge and their roots capped with warm GOLD bands set with amber resin.

items.name: research-ants-mandibles-3
items.title: Mandibles III
items.subject: MANDIBLES III, the royal mandibles: the same pair in glossy ivory with ornate gold caps, ROYAL-BLUE chitin plates at their roots, and veins of glowing violet LIQUID substance running along each blade to its bright tip.

items.name: research-ants-carapace-1
items.title: Carapace I
items.subject: CARAPACE I (ant troops gain armour, the first and plainest of three levels): one thick curved ant carapace plate alone, like a section of an ant's back armour, made of three broad overlapping chitin segments, angled diagonally, of PLAIN DULL SAND-BROWN GROWN CHITIN, matte with a slightly rough grain. No gold, no amber, no blue, no glow.

items.name: research-ants-carapace-2
items.title: Carapace II
items.subject: CARAPACE II: the same carapace plate, now HARDENED and GLOSSY warm bronze chitin, its segment edges rimmed with GOLD and its seams sealed with warm amber resin.

items.name: research-ants-carapace-3
items.title: Carapace III
items.subject: CARAPACE III, the royal carapace: the same plate in glossy bronze with ornate gold rims, its middle segment glazed ROYAL BLUE, and veins of glowing violet LIQUID substance running through the amber seams.

items.name: research-ants-needle-hardening-1
items.title: Needle Hardening I
items.refnote: the first image is the Needler: take only the thick tapered shape of its back quills, three of them, in plain dull chitin without its violet tips; do not draw the ant or its blue hood.
items.subject: NEEDLE HARDENING I (Needlers, Honeypots, Alates and Acid Spires hit harder, the first and plainest of three levels): three thick tapered chitin needles alone, fanned out from one small rounded chitin base, angled diagonally toward the upper right, of PLAIN DULL SAND-BROWN GROWN CHITIN, matte, their tips blunt and dull. No gold, no amber, no blue, no glow.

items.name: research-ants-needle-hardening-2
items.title: Needle Hardening II
items.subject: NEEDLE HARDENING II: the same three needles, now HARDENED GLOSSY bronze chitin, their tips glazed with hard clear AMBER to sharp gleaming points, a GOLD ring around the base.

items.name: research-ants-needle-hardening-3
items.title: Needle Hardening III
items.subject: NEEDLE HARDENING III, the royal needles: the same three needles in glossy bronze with an ornate gold base set with a ROYAL-BLUE plate, veins of glowing violet LIQUID substance running up each shaft into brightly glowing violet tips.

items.name: research-ants-wider-tunnels-1
items.title: Wider Tunnels I
items.subject: WIDER TUNNELS I (more ants pass through the tunnels each second, the plainer of two levels): one wide round tunnel mouth alone, a thick ring of sculpted SAND CLAY seen at an angle so its deep dark opening shows, the clay PLAIN, rough and hand-smoothed. No gold, no amber, no blue, no glow inside. Only the tunnel mouth: no mound, no ground around it.

items.name: research-ants-wider-tunnels-2
items.title: Wider Tunnels II
items.subject: WIDER TUNNELS II, the royal tunnel: the same tunnel mouth, its clay ring now polished smooth and glazed with warm AMBER resin, inlaid with a GOLD rim and ROYAL-BLUE clay bands, and soft violet LIQUID substance light glowing deep inside the opening.

items.name: research-ants-barbed-needles
items.refnote: the first image is the Needler: take only the shape and bronze chitin of one of its back quills; do not draw the ant, its hood or its other quills.
items.subject: BARBED NEEDLES (Needler hits strip the target's armour): one single long thick chitin needle alone, angled diagonally with its point toward the upper right, of glossy bronze chitin, its shaft set with three big chunky backward-hooked barbs of ivory chitin, each barb clearly separate. Only the needle: no ant, no target.

items.name: research-ants-hardened-wings
items.refnote: the first image is the Alate: take only the shape and blue-violet membranes of its wings, with thicker bronze veins; do not draw the ant or what it carries.
items.subject: HARDENED WINGS (Alates gain health and fly faster): one pair of ant wings alone, spread in a swept-back V, angled diagonally, their membranes translucent blue-violet, framed and crossed by THICK glossy BRONZE CHITIN veins like a strong grown frame, their front edges rimmed in gold. Only the wings: no body.

items.name: research-ants-living-wall
items.refnote: the first image is the Major: draw only its leaf-shaped royal-blue shield, keeping its shape and leaf veins; do not draw the ant or its club.
items.subject: LIVING WALL (Majors gain armour and their Guard shields small ants better): the Major's great leaf-shaped royal-blue shield alone, upright and angled diagonally, its pale ivory rim grown into a thick double border of overlapping glossy bronze chitin plates sealed with amber resin. Only the shield: no ant, no weapon.

items.name: research-ants-sticky-nectar
items.refnote: the first image is the Honeypot: take only the glowing golden-amber nectar of its sac; do not draw the ants or the sac.
items.subject: STICKY NECTAR (Honeypot globs splash wider and slow the survivors): one fat glob of thick glossy golden-amber nectar alone, flying from the lower left to the upper right, glowing warmly from within, two short thick drips sagging from its underside and a few round bubbles inside it. Only the glob: no ant.

items.name: research-ants-pheromone-mastery
items.refnote: the first image is the Herald: take only its feathered plumes, two of them, broad and bold; do not draw the ant, its robes or its staff.
items.subject: PHEROMONE MASTERY (Heralds learn Panic, Gardeners learn Spore Cloud): two broad feathered ant antennae alone, rising in a V like two thick golden-brown fern fronds, their tips glowing violet, one bold curl of violet pheromone mist twisting up between them. Only the antennae: no head, no ant.

items.name: research-ants-venom-glands
items.refnote: the first image is the Bullet Ant: take only its dark red-black chitin and violet stinger tip; do not draw the ant or its golden mane.
items.subject: VENOM GLANDS (the Bullet Ant's Agony lingers longer): the tip of the Bullet Ant's abdomen alone, a thick curved dark red-black chitin stinger rising from one plump translucent venom gland swollen with glowing violet liquid, one heavy violet drop hanging from the stinger's point, angled diagonally. Only the stinger and gland: no ant.

items.name: research-ants-volatile-sacs
items.refnote: the first image is the Burster: take only the glowing violet liquid inside its sac; do not draw the ant, its round shape or its blue straps.
items.subject: VOLATILE SACS (Burster bursts hit harder and spare allies): one heavy swollen teardrop-shaped sac alone, its translucent skin full of glowing violet liquid substance, held in by thick ribs of glossy bronze chitin that curve around it, its narrow neck tied off with one fat gold ring, angled diagonally. Only the sac: no ant, no straps.
